study type: Prospective cohort study with propensity score matching
outcome: Need of supplemental oxygen at PMA 36 weeks
Need of supplemental oxygen at PMA 40 weeks
Need of positive pressure respiratory support at PMA 36 weeks
Need of positive pressure respiratory support at PMA 40 weeks
cohort: Infants born at 25-27 weeks gestational age, admitted to neonatal intensive care units in Norway between 2012-2018.
finding: Less invasive surfactant administration (LISA) significantly reduced the rate and duration of mechanical ventilation compared to primary endotracheal intubation, but showed no other clear benefits for the measured outcomes.
